    datetime_features = [col for col in df.columns if df[col].dtype == 'datetime64[ns]']

        df[f'{col}_month'] = df[col].dt.month
        df[f'{col}_day'] = df[col].dt.day
        df[f'{col}_dayofweek'] = df[col].dt.dayofweek

    CREATED_FEATURES = []

    constant_cols = df.columns[df.nunique() <= 1]
    duplicate_cols = df.columns[df.columns.duplicated()]
    df.drop(columns=constant_cols.union(duplicate_cols).union(DROPPED_FEATURES), inplace=True)

    if 'Bare_Nuclei' in df.columns:
        df['Bare_Nuclei_Most_Frequent'] = df['Bare_Nuclei'].fillna(df['Bare_Nuclei'].mode()[0])
        CREATED_FEATURES.append('Bare_Nuclei_Most_Frequent')
    
    # Decompose datetime columns (none in this dataset)
    
    # Create per-row derived features
    df['Cell_Size_Ratio'] = df['Cell_Size_Uniformity'] / df['Cell_Shape_Uniformity']
